answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 21620 Country: India Title: i have a pigme account in amanath bank.i took 25000/- from my account but now the banker is telling me that i should not withdraw amount from my account till 9 months are completed,so he is telling me that he has given that amount as loan for 1% is it jayaz or haram. Question: assalamualaikum respected sir,i have a pigme account in amanath bank.i took 25000/- from my account but now the banker is telling me that i should not withdraw amount from my account till 9 months are completed,so he is telling me that he has given that amount as loan for 1% is it jayaz or haram. Answer ID: 21620 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 693/494/L=1431) Giving loan on interest is unlawful and haram though the rate of interest is only one percent. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
